title: Gen AI Platform for Automated Content Transformation
description:
• Background Organisations frequently need to convert information available in different forms such as news articles, reports, advisories, threat intelligence, policy documents, research papers, announcements, incident reports or free-form prompts into specific communication artefacts suitable for various purposes. The process of manually analysing the source content, understanding the desired objective and creating the required output format is time-consuming, resource-intensive and often requires expertise in content creation, communication and domain knowledge.
There is a need for an intelligent platform that can transform user-provided content into a desired output format through a simple and configurable interface.
• Description The system shall act as an AI-powered content transformation engine that converts a common source of information into the specific deliverable requested by the operator, thereby reducing manual effort, improving consistency, accelerating content creation and enhancing operational efficiency.
The platform shall provide a dashboard through which an operator can submit source content in the form of high quality English language text, documents, articles, reports, prompts, images, videos or contextual information. In addition to providing the source content, the operator shall select one or more desired output types through configurable parameters available on the dashboard.
Based on the submitted content and the selected output type(s), the platform shall analyze the input, understand the context and intent, and generate the requested output artefact. The platform should support multiple output formats and allow operators to control generation parameters such as target audience, tone, language, level of detail, communication objective and content style.
In summary, platform shall generate output corresponding to the option(s) selected by the operator on the dashboard.
• Examples include
• If 'Video' is selected, generate a complete video package including script, storyboard, scene descriptions, narration text, subtitles and visual recommendations.
• If 'LinkedIn Post' is selected, generate a professional LinkedIn post suitable for publication.
• If 'Twitter/X Post' is selected, generate platform-optimized tweets or tweet threads.
• If 'Advisory' is selected, generate a structured advisory document.
• If 'Infographic' is selected, generate infographic content, layout recommendations and key messaging.
• If 'Executive Summary' is selected, generate a concise executive briefing.
• If 'Presentation' is selected, generate presentation slides and speaker notes.
• If multiple output formats are selected, generate all selected deliverables from the same source content.
• Expected Solution/Deliverables for Evaluation
• Source Code Link (GitHub/Drive Link)
• Readme with Setup Instructions
• Architecture Document (Max 2 Pages)
• Demo Video (Max 2 Minutes)
• Technical Presentation (Max 5 Slides)
summary: Innovation (3/5): draws on ai applied to a smart automation problem, placing it in the moderate band. Feasibility (3/5): as a software build with moderate integration complexity, a full build is tight for 36 hours and will need scope-cutting. Impact (2/5): addresses a more targeted user group within Smart Automation. Tech Depth (3/5): centers on architecture. Sustainability (4/5): has a clear long-term maintenance path. Scalability (2/5): currently scoped narrowly and would need rework to scale. Total 17/30 -> Yellow verdict.

detail.title: Gen AI Platform for Automated Content Transformation

overview.in_plain_terms: Build a platform where an operator submits source content, a report, article, or advisory, and specifies a desired output format, and the system automatically transforms it into that specific deliverable, a press release, summary brief, or social post, saving the manual work of reformatting content for different purposes.
overview.why_it_matters: Manually converting the same source information into different communication formats for different purposes is slow and requires specific expertise. A genuinely configurable transformation engine saves real time across many organizational workflows.
pain_points: Manually analyzing source content and converting it into specific output formats is time-consuming.
Requires expertise in content creation, communication, and domain knowledge for good results.
No configurable, general-purpose platform handles this transformation task systematically.
overview.background: Organizations frequently need to convert source content (reports, advisories, articles) into specific communication deliverables, currently a manual, expertise-dependent, time-consuming process.
overview.whats_being_asked: An AI-powered content transformation platform where an operator submits source content and specifies a desired output format/deliverable, and the system generates the transformed output through a configurable interface.
expected_solution: Configurable dashboard for source content submission (text, documents, articles).
Consistent, high-quality output across varied source/target format combinations.

analysis.innovation_scope_note: Moderate. Content transformation/summarization using LLMs is an established application pattern, the value is in genuine configurability and quality consistency across varied formats.
analysis.invention_effort_note: Moderate. Achievable using established LLM-based content generation techniques; real effort in the configuration interface and maintaining quality/accuracy across transformation types.

competitive_landscape.note: Content-generation/transformation platforms are a fairly common LLM-application hackathon category, differentiation needs genuine configurability and format-consistency quality.

innovation.note: Established LLM content-generation pattern, value is in genuine configurable, multi-format consistency.

invention.note: Achievable using established LLM techniques, real effort in configuration UX and quality control.

technical_feasibility.note: LLM-based content transformation is well-supported by existing tooling and APIs.

impact_and_benefits.note: Genuine time-savings value for organizations doing repeated content transformation.

architecture.note: A configuration layer plus LLM generation pipeline, well-understood pattern.

overall_verdict.reasoning: Yellow, genuinely achievable, moderate crowding in this common LLM-application category. Differentiate through genuine accuracy preservation (the transformed output shouldn't distort or fabricate facts from the source), a real risk for content-transformation LLM applications.

evaluator_lens.biggest_strength: Well-supported underlying technology (LLM content generation) makes this genuinely achievable in 36 hours.
evaluator_lens.biggest_risk: LLM-based content transformation can subtly distort or fabricate details from source content, especially for sensitive source material (threat intelligence, advisories named in the PS), factual accuracy preservation is a real, important concern.
evaluator_lens.validate_before_commit: Build in explicit fact-preservation validation, comparing key facts/figures in transformed output against the source content, and flag potential discrepancies rather than assuming the transformation is always faithful.

idea_0_4: Design your configuration interface for source content input and output-format specification.
Design your fact-preservation validation approach (comparing key entities/figures between source and output).
Split: one person on the transformation pipeline, one on the configuration UI and validation layer.
prototype_4_22: Build source content ingestion (text, document upload).
Build the LLM-based transformation engine with configurable output-format templates.
integration_22_30: Connect ingestion, transformation, and validation into one coherent pipeline.
Test with genuinely varied source-to-output combinations (a technical report to a summary brief, an article to a social post).
Test your fact-preservation validation against a deliberately altered/hallucinated test case.
polish_30_36: Polish the operator dashboard for genuine usability.
Rehearse a live demo transforming real source content into multiple different output formats.
Prepare to discuss your fact-preservation validation approach explicitly.
build_plan.how_to_stand_out: Show your fact-preservation validation catching a deliberately introduced discrepancy between source and transformed output, live, that accuracy safeguard is what separates a genuinely trustworthy content-transformation tool from one that could silently distort important source material.

strengths: Well-supported underlying LLM technology, genuinely achievable.
Real efficiency value for organizations with repeated content-transformation needs.
weaknesses: Moderate crowding in the common LLM content-generation hackathon category.
Real risk of subtle fact distortion in transformation, needs deliberate validation to be trustworthy.

team_fit.ideal_ratio: Balanced, with real attention to the fact-preservation validation layer.
team_fit.approach: Build fact-preservation validation alongside the transformation engine from the start, not as an afterthought.

ai_buildability_split.ai_can_build_fast: The core LLM-based transformation pipeline and configuration UI.
ai_buildability_split.needs_human_judgment: Designing genuine fact-preservation validation that catches subtle distortions, that requires careful thought about what could go wrong in LLM-based transformation, not blind trust in the output.
ai_buildability_split.risk_of_leaning_on_ai_only: An LLM-based transformation system without deliberate fact-preservation validation could silently distort or fabricate details, especially concerning given the PS names sensitive source types like threat intelligence and advisories.

data_resource_availability.status: No specific dataset dependency, sample source documents (reports, articles) are sufficient for a demo.

judge_qna.question: How do you ensure the transformed output doesn't distort or fabricate facts from the source content?
judge_qna.strong_answer: Walk through your specific fact-preservation validation approach, comparing key entities/figures between source and output, and demonstrate it catching a deliberately introduced discrepancy.
judge_qna.follow_up: What happens when your validation detects a discrepancy, does it block the output or just flag it?

judge_qna.question: How does this handle genuinely sensitive source content, like the threat intelligence or advisories mentioned in the problem?
judge_qna.strong_answer: Discuss any additional safeguards for sensitive content types, access control, audit logging, or human review requirements before sensitive transformed content is distributed.
judge_qna.follow_up: Who would be responsible for reviewing transformed output before it's used operationally?
